Flow: conditional growth references (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.23.26363771)

Source: R/flow-distribution.R
wgh_flow_conditional_references.Rd

Conditioning-window to target-age panel, conditional quantile references by sex and target age, child-level cross-validation and leave-one-site-out validation against the unconditional, persistence and WHO-band benchmarks (pinball loss, CRPS, WIS, coverage and width), calibration by quantile, the conditional centile of every observed target value with the share flagged below the 3rd or above the 97th centile, and fan charts for two example children with their later measurements.

Usage

wgh_flow_conditional_references(
  x = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  window = c(5, 10),
  targets = c(12, 15)
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with height, weight and year. When NULL, a simulated wgh_like cohort is generated.

mode

Run mode (see wgh_config()); NULL keeps the current mode.

window, targets

Conditioning window and target ages.

Value

A wgh_report.

Examples

# \donttest{
rep <- wgh_flow_conditional_references(growdat, mode = "dev", window = c(5, 9), targets = c(10, 12))
rep
#> 
#> ── Conditional growth references (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.23.26363771) ──
#> 
#> Tables (9): panel_size, table1, coefficients_median, cv_scores_by_fold,
#> cv_scores, leave_one_site_out, calibration, centiles, flags
#> Figures (4): fig_scores, fig_calibration, fig_fan_low, fig_fan_high
#> Models: condref
#> Settings: mode = dev; window = 5/9; targets = 10/12
